DESIGNATION



Senior Associate Consultant

ROLES AND RESPONSIBLITIES

To pursuea challenging career as an SAP EWM Consultant with an aim to satisfy the client and employer and with a view to continually strive for excellence and improvisation

PROJECTS: 1 IMPLEMENTATION , 1 ROLLOUT AND 2 POST GO-LIVE SUPPORT

Project experience

Project-Vodafone Newzeland

Duration-6 months Responsibilities –

Involved in realization phase of the implementation. Configuration of EWM organization levels and its assignment. Configuration of all master data as per the client requirement. Configuring different warehouse process types. Configuring LOSC and POSC . EWM and MM testing all transactions, Integration testing, user acceptance testing.

Project-Hitachi Reiwa Rollout

Duration – 1.3 years Responsibilities –

Completed one End to End Rollout project. Supported in cutover activities, ITC and UAT and hyper care after go live. Experience in Configuration of EWM Warehouse structure. Experience in defining storage areas, storage bins and managing them. Configured Activity areas setup. Worked in defining warehouse process type for different process. Worked on Integration setup between ERP and EWM. Worked on Queue determination and resource. Worked in data migration activities for different objects related to master data and transactional data.

Project-Hitachi Reiwa AMS

Duration – 1.4 years and currently woking

Responsibilities –

Providing support to more than 35 countries which are the part of Hitachi energy. Implemented forms Related new requirements globally which was helpful to all countries. Provided quick support to the user by analyzing their issues with proper guidelines. Worked on Incidents related to different warehouse issues in service snow. Provided required missing configuration by checking with user using CR-CD process. Worked on Queue monitoring of different warehouses. Worked in Regression testing.

SAP EWM CONSULTANT

Strengths

Positive Mindset Good team player Quick learner

Certifications

AI Ethics at SAP Generative AI at SAP

SAP Certified Associate-SAP S/4 HANA Cloud Private Edition, Extended Warehouse management

Provided Effective Resolution to the business by performing regression Testing during new releases. Responsible to ensure the WH operations are running smooth by interaction with the user and providing solutions for delivery related issues and giving them training.

Moglix(05 Aug 2021 to 18 sept 2021)

Worked in supply chain unit PO creations as per the quotation recieved. Managing delivery of the items. Following up with the customer for delivery issues Managing items in the warehouse. Good relationship with the customers

Bharat Electronics Limited (15 feb 2020 to 24 june 2021)

Responsibilities –

SAP EWM and MM End user. Creation of PO against PR and MRP run, Sending RFQ, receiving quotations, Making comparative statements, Creation of BID and publishing in SRM. Knowledge of workflow of Purchase Requisition (PR), Purchase Order (PO), and Purchasing Info record, Source lists, contracts, scheduling agreements. Worked in Subcontracting Process. Complete analysis of Procure to Pay cycle, Negotiation with vendor and vendor management and follow up with the vendor after releasing the orders. Worked in Inbound and outbound process. Scheduled delivery of the items collected item and completed quality check of the items. Arranging pick-up of ordered parts from vendor premise with freight forwarders, Coordinating with D&E, Production and Quality team for fulfilment of the requirement and resolving the product related issues. Maintained items in warehouse according to the bins provided.
